input.summary: Add Array defence duty, express IP infringement indemnity and law/confidentiality/GN-WM heads; narrow Ono's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Array's indemnity omits any third party intellectual property infringement indemnity, so we have added an express one that overrides the "own expense" defence allocation in Section 11.4, together with a duty to defend and cover for Array's breach of Law, unauthorized disclosure of our Confidential Information and Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct. In exchange we have narrowed Ono's indemnity to Ono-supplied materials and Ono's breach of Law, deleting its product-liability and Article 15 prongs; we can restore the reciprocal product-liability and clinical-study allocation if Array accepts the IP indemnity.

ops.oldText: Array shall indemnify and hold harmless
ops.newText: Array shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless

ops.oldText: (b) injury or death of patients participating in any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Array anywhere in the world, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (c) injury or death of patients participating in Clinical Studies conducted under any Joint Development Plan and sponsored by or on behalf of Array, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
ops.newText: (b) injury or death of patients participating in any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Array anywhere in the world, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (c) injury or death of patients participating in Clinical Studies conducted under any Joint Development Plan and sponsored by or on behalf of Array, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, (e) Array's breach of applicable Law, (f) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Ono's Confidential Information caused by Array, and (g) Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Section 11.4, Array shall defend and indemnify the Ono Indemnitees against any Third Party Claim alleging that any Product, or any deliverable or service supplied by Array hereunder, infringes or misappropriates the intellectual property rights of a Third Party.

ops.oldText: (a) the use, marketing, distribution, importation or sale of any Product by Ono, its Affiliates or Sublicensees in the Ono Territory, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom;
ops.newText: (a) materials, data or content provided by Ono to Array under this Agreement; and

ops.oldText: (b) injury or death of patients participating in any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Ono anywhere in the world, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (c) injury or death of patients participating in Clinical Studies conducted under any Joint Development Plan and sponsored by or on behalf of Ono, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Ono in Article 15 above; except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of an Array Indemnitee.
ops.newText: (b) Ono's breach of applicable Law; except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of an Array Indemnitee.
